title: The marketplace
sub: Film 6 of 6 of Governance you can use: the marketplace. The university's data products sit in one catalogue: you read a product's promise, ask its owner with a reason and an end date, get access through a group until that date, and become a reader the impact check names; outside the university, a product is shared through OpenSharing and read where it lives.
howto: The film is painted in watercolour, in the university's own rooms. Behind each person, a soft wash of their side: gold for the business side, cyan for the technical side. Each product keeps one colour on every tile and file, and its owner's chip is gold; codes that can lead back to a learner are pale plum. A small key with a date on its tag is access until that date. Files are paper sheets, copied from the example project; the catalogue's and the platform's pages are drawn as forms.
